verificationItems.text: Confirm the Firehose delivery stream status shows Active in the Amazon Data Firehose console.
Confirm the S3 destination bucket has been created and the delivery stream is configured with the correct buffer interval and buffer size.
Confirm the delivery stream uses Direct PUT as the source and Amazon S3 as the destination.

cleanupItems.text: Open the Amazon Data Firehose console and select the analytics-lake-ingest delivery stream.
Click Delete to remove the delivery stream. Confirm deletion. (Note: delete-delivery-stream is destructive and cannot be undone.)
Open the Amazon S3 console, find the destination bucket (e.g. saa-analytics-sink-[account-id]), empty the bucket, then delete it.
If an IAM role was created solely for this lab, open the IAM console and delete the role and its inline policies.
If a CloudWatch log group was created for Firehose error logging, open CloudWatch Logs and delete the log group.

verificationItems.text: Confirm Route 53 health checks show Healthy status for the primary endpoint.
Confirm DNS failover records exist for both primary and secondary endpoints with correct TTL.
Confirm that simulating a primary failure triggers Route 53 to route traffic to the secondary endpoint.

cleanupItems.text: Delete all test Route 53 health checks created for this lab.
Remove the failover DNS records (primary and secondary) from the hosted zone.
Delete the hosted zone only if it was created solely for this lab.
Delete CloudWatch alarms and SNS notifications created for health-check monitoring.

verificationItems.text: Confirm you can articulate the RTO and RPO trade-offs for each of the four AWS DR strategies: backup-and-restore, pilot light, warm standby, and multi-site active-active.
Confirm the pilot light configuration has core services running but non-critical capacity at minimum scale.
Confirm the warm standby configuration has a reduced but fully operational environment ready to scale up.

cleanupItems.text: Terminate any disposable EC2 instances, RDS instances or other resources created to represent pilot light or warm standby environments.
Delete test AMIs, snapshots, or cross-region replicas created solely for this exercise.
Delete IAM roles, CloudWatch alarms and Route 53 health checks created solely for the lab.
Remove cross-region replication configuration if enabled solely for the lab.
